dct_description_sm: "Published June 28th, 1800 by John Wallis at his Map Warehouse, 16 Ludgate Street."

"Published June 28th, 1800 by John Wallis at his Map Warehouse, 16 Ludgate Street." Map consists of 2 hemispheres each 20 cm. in diam. Includes 6 ancillary maps showing circles, parallels, zones, meridians, definitions of land and water, and world. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image.
